method: SymPy exact simplification; all displayed residuals are zero identities. Deliberately incorrect controls are required to have nonzero exact residuals.

positivity_scope: The imaginary-part expressions have positive numerator and strictly positive denominator under the stated real assumptions; no numerical sample establishes a uniform analytic estimate.
scope: Exact finite symbolic algebra only. No contour bounds, uniformity, Gaussian asymptotics, H1/H2, actual-source amplitude, or volume theorem is proved.
